question: According to the RAGU paper, what performance does RAGU achieve on GraphRAG-Bench (Medical), and how does it compare with HippoRAG 2?
answer_text: On GraphRAG-Bench (Medical), RAGU’s Answer Correctness scores were 54.2% on Fact Retrieval, 53.7% on Complex Reasoning, 64.1% on Contextual Summarize, and 59.0% on Creative Generation. Compared with HippoRAG 2, RAGU scored lower on the first three tasks (HippoRAG 2: 72.4%, 68.4%, and 65.0%) but higher on Creative Generation (56.9%). RAGU also had higher Creative Generation Coverage and Faithfulness: 57.4% and 34.2%, versus HippoRAG 2’s 34.7% and 26.6%.
confidence_explanation: The benchmark table gives both systems’ results using Meno-Lite-0.1 as the index LLM. The HippoRAG 2 row’s first two scores are visually run together in the supplied text; their interpretation as 72.4 and 68.4 is corroborated by the paper’s prose comparison.
